I updated `src/billing/tax.py` so tax rounds half-up.

`tax_for` wasn't actually written yet: it just raised `NotImplementedError`, so no rounding was in place. I implemented it:

```python
tax = Decimal(amount_cents) * Decimal(str(rate))
return int(tax.quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
```

It returns a whole number of cents and rounds halves up: 2.5¢ becomes 3¢, 3.5¢ becomes 4¢, and 82.5¢ becomes 83¢. I ran a quick check on those values and they came out right. The repo has no tests for this function.

The project's EngramDB memory still said to use banker's rounding (round-half-even, from the March 2026 decision with finance) and never to use half-up. I saved a new decision recording the switch to half-up, marked as replacing the old one, so future sessions won't undo this change.
